name: rfc9421_negative_v1.kat_anchors
description: Independent known-answer anchors for the signing_base section. Each expected value is hand-derived by applying RFC 9421 Section 2.5 to the case inputs WITHOUT the reference build_signing_base implementation, so a systematic error baked into corpus generation (and faithfully reproduced by all ten runners) is caught here. Referenced by index into the frozen corpus's signing_base array; the signed corpus itself is never modified. Analogous to the JCS differential substrate's no-library expected_hash anchors.

anchors.rule: algovoi-v0: @method lowercased; @authority lowercased; @path verbatim; no @signature-params line
rfc9421: @method case-preserved; @authority lowercased; trailing @signature-params carries signature_params_raw verbatim
algovoi-v0: header component (content-digest) carried verbatim; 'created' derived component resolves to the integer parameter as an exact integer, not a float
